RE: NEW TOBACCO UPDATES

This memo is to inform you of several changes in the tobacco program. There are several Schematic & Price Book changes that need to be reviewed & placed in your office manuals. The changes are as follows:

1- Doral, Monarch, and Best Value are now going to be discounted off invoice from Mclane. This will be done as GPC is currently done. Doral will be $2.00 off invoice which is the same as GPC. Monarch, and Best Value will be $2.50 off invoice. This is effective immediately, except in the states of Montana and Arkansas where it is illegal. Those locations will receive their money as it is currently being done (1100 distribution). All locations must purchase their Dorals, Monarchs, Best Value, and GPC brands thru Mclane to receive the off invoice amounts. Any extra buydowns on those brands are handled by your local RJR and B&W representatives.

2- All Camel / Winston $2.00 off will still be done thru proof of purchase. RJR gathers your purchase information from Mclane and pays us $2.00 off per carton on those purchases which is applied to the 1100 report.

Enclosed are new Price Book pages.
